intent.caption: Photo hero composite — A layered photographic hero plate with filmic grade, foreground subject separation, and caption block.

textContent.text: Every case begins as a single billet of 904L steel.

visualSpec.effects: Layered photo plate 4.0w x 2.5h scene units on parallax-plane using the provided imageUrl and depthMapUrl, depth-displacement amplitude 0.18 scene units, parallax-scroll intensity 0.35 bound to scroll; filmic grade baked into the plate treatment: blacks lifted to #0d0d12, highlights shouldered toward #e8ecf2, midtone contrast plus 12 percent, global desaturation minus 8 percent with the red channel preserved so the accent stays pure; foreground subject separated by the depth map with a 0.02-unit rim of key light along its silhouette; bottom scrim gradient #0b0b1000 (at 0.45) -> #0b0b10eb (at 1.0) seats the caption block; caption block anchored bottom-left with 0.5-unit padding (2x base unit), kicker then headline then body stacked on a 0.25-unit baseline rhythm; accent hairline bar 0.75w x 0.02h in #ff2a38 emissive intensity 1.8 sits between headline and body; plate mount opacity 0 -> 1 over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); caption block rise-in y +0.4 -> 0 over 700ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1) starting 120ms after the plate; scroll shifts depth layers up to plus and minus 0.14 units against the camera so near layers overtake far layers with true occlusion.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Depth layers parallax against scroll at 0.35 intensity while the caption block rises in once and stays fixed.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 body text on the scrim region; 3:1 headline on graded plate
